c.n: Salt the ribs the day before. Sear hard on every side until deep brown.
c.s: Salt the ribs the day before. Sear hard on every side until deep brown.

c.n: Cover with the braising liquid, lid on, in a 300°F oven until fork-tender.
c.s: Cover with the braising liquid, lid on, in a 300°F oven until fork-tender.

c.n: Cool in the liquid overnight. Portion cold so each piece holds its shape.
c.s: Cool in the liquid overnight. Portion cold so each piece holds its shape.

c.n: Skim the fat, then reduce the braising liquid until it coats a spoon.
c.s: Skim the fat, then reduce the braising liquid until it coats a spoon.

c.n: Reheat a portion in its gravy. Wilt the spinach in the same pan.
c.s: Reheat a portion in its gravy. Wilt the spinach in the same pan.

c.n: Spinach first, rib on top, gravy over, carrot ribbon last. Wipe the rim.
